title: Claude Fable 5 & the Mythos Tier
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** — the first generally available model in a new **Mythos tier**, which sits above Opus in Anthropic's model family. Alongside it came **Claude Mythos 5**, the same underlying model with fewer safety classifiers, available only to a limited set of vetted cybersecurity researchers and infrastructure operators through **Project Glasswing**.

The release introduces a fourth capability tier (Haiku → Sonnet → Opus → Fable/Mythos) and represents the largest single benchmark jump since Claude 3.5 Sonnet surpassed Claude 3 Opus in mid-2024.

---

## Designed for Long-Horizon Tasks

Fable 5 targets ambitious, asynchronous tasks that earlier Claude models couldn't sustain:

- **Large-scale code migrations** across hundreds of files in a single agent session
- **Multi-day agentic workflows** with persistent memory and task checkpointing
- **Dense knowledge synthesis** across thousands of pages of source material
- **Deep research** combining web retrieval, document analysis, and structured output

---

## Benchmark Performance

| Benchmark | Fable 5 / Mythos 5 | Opus 4.8 | GPT-5.5 | Gemini 3.1 Pro |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | 69.2% | 58.6% | 54.2% |
| Terminal-Bench 2.1 | **88.0%** | 82.7% | 83.4% | 70.7% |
| GDPval-AA (score) | **1932** | 1890 | 1769 | 1314 |
| Humanity's Last Exam (no tools) | **59.0%** | — | — | — |
| Humanity's Last Exam (with tools) | **64.5%** | — | — | — |

---

## The Fable vs. Mythos Split

The two models share the same weights but differ in their safety classifiers:

- **Claude Fable 5** includes classifiers that route certain high-risk queries to a fallback model. Anthropic states fallback activates in fewer than 5% of sessions; users see no indication when it fires.
- **Claude Mythos 5** removes those classifiers. On cybersecurity evaluations, Mythos 5 scores 78.0% vs. Opus 4.8's 40.0% — nearly double. Access is restricted to Project Glasswing participants only.

---

## Specs & Pricing

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Context window | 200K input tokens |
| Max output tokens | 128K per response |
| Input price | $10 per million tokens |
| Output price | $50 per million tokens |
| Model ID | `claude-fable-5` |

Fable 5 is priced at double Claude Opus 4.8 and double GPT-5.5 on input.

```python
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-fable-5",
    max_tokens=8192,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Migrate this 50-file codebase from Python 2 to 3..."}]
)
```

---

## Export Control Suspension (June 12, 2026)

Three days after launch, Anthropic announced a US government export-control directive requiring suspension of Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access for users in affected jurisdictions. All other Claude models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) remained unaffected. Anthropic stated it is working with regulators to restore full access.

---

## Position in the Full Model Family

| Tier | Current Model | Primary Use Case |
|---|---|---|
| Haiku | `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` | High-throughput, cost-sensitive |
| Sonnet | `claude-sonnet-4-6` | Balanced capability and cost |
| Opus | `claude-opus-4-8` | Complex reasoning, agentic work |
| **Fable** | **`claude-fable-5`** | **Frontier long-horizon tasks** |
